name: kinetra
description: Kinetra Codex plugin: local-first Karnaugh maps, circuit analysis, physics diagrams, retrieval, study plans, and assessment for technical engineering coursework.

interface.longDescription: Kinetra is a local-first technical learning and engineering workbench. This Codex plugin exposes six skills that route into Kinetra's deterministic TypeScript core for Karnaugh maps, DC/transient circuit analysis, physics diagrams, lexical+vector retrieval, study-plan generation, and quiz/exam generation.
defaultPrompt: Solve this 4-variable K-map for minimum SOP
Analyze an RC low-pass filter transient and plot V(t)
Build a hybrid retrieval index over my lecture notes
